roads.name: Cape San Blas Road
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 2.0 miles, about 9 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From -2 to 8 ft, with 39 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 15 mph limit its corners ask for only about 0.08 g, so the limit, not the curves, sets the pace.
